source.source: DARKO Daily Plus-Minus by Kostya Medvedovsky (darko.app)
limitations: DARKO's retrospective pregame forecast at the phase's last admitted game date; not a season average or a CourtLens estimate. Higher is better for DPM, ODPM and DDPM.
Historical ratings are published retrospectively; original publication-time model versions are unavailable. Never used as CourtLens forecasting features.
Different dates or model revisions can differ from Databallr. Percentiles are CourtLens league ranks, not DARKO or Databallr percentiles.
